name: Admin Proposal Contract Modality
description: The administrator changes single/split in every proposal state. Outside negotiation a required note and owned preview precede confirm/cancel. Three explicit service terms are required for split. Custom text and PDF are preserved literally; conflicting custom destinations require explicit resolution. Previous contracts and linked sent/signed documents remain intact without automatic delivery or signatures. Permanent snapshots can be consulted, downloaded and restored from proposal history with a new reviewed change. Existing service-generation dialogs retain their own presets, validation, stale-contract warnings and compact responsive layout.
